import Mathlib

structure BFSGraph where
  adj : Array (Array Nat)

def BFSGraph.well_formed (g : BFSGraph) : Prop :=
  ∀ u, u < g.adj.size →
    ∀ v, v ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] → v < g.adj.size

def BFSGraph.size (g : BFSGraph) : Nat :=
  g.adj.size

def BFSGraph.has_edge (g : BFSGraph) (u v : Nat) : Prop :=
  u < g.adj.size ∧
  v ∈ g.adj.getD u #[]

def BFSGraph.is_path (g : BFSGraph) (p : List Nat) : Prop :=
  p.length > 0 ∧
  ∀ i, i + 1 < p.length →
    g.has_edge (p.getD i 0) (p.getD (i + 1) 0)

def BFSGraph.reachable (g : BFSGraph) (start target : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∃ p, g.is_path p ∧ p.head? = some start ∧ p.getLast? = some target

def BFSGraph.is_shortest_distance (g : BFSGraph) (start target : Nat) (d : Nat) : Prop :=
  (∃ p, g.is_path p ∧ p.head? = some start ∧ p.getLast? = some target ∧ p.length = d + 1) ∧
  (∀ p, g.is_path p → p.head? = some start → p.getLast? = some target → p.length ≥ d + 1)

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def bfs_shortest_path_precond (graph : BFSGraph) (start target : Nat) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  graph.well_formed ∧ graph.size ≤ 10000 ∧ start < graph.size ∧ target < graph.size
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode
/-- One BFS expansion step: add all out-neighbours of the current frontier set. -/
def bfsStep (g : BFSGraph) (S : Finset Nat) : Finset Nat :=
  S ∪ S.biUnion (fun u => ((g.adj.getD u #[]).toList).toFinset)

/-- `bfsLevel g start k` is the set of nodes reachable from `start` using at most `k` edges. -/
def bfsLevel (g : BFSGraph) (start : Nat) : Nat → Finset Nat
  | 0 => {start}
  | k + 1 => bfsStep g (bfsLevel g start k)
-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definition
def bfs_shortest_path (graph : BFSGraph) (start target : Nat)
    (h_precond : bfs_shortest_path_precond graph start target) : Option Nat :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  if hh : target ∈ bfsLevel graph start graph.adj.size then
    some (Nat.find (p := fun k => target ∈ bfsLevel graph start k) ⟨graph.adj.size, hh⟩)
  else
    none
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def bfs_shortest_path_postcond (graph : BFSGraph) (start target : Nat) (result : Option Nat)
    (_ : bfs_shortest_path_precond graph start target) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  match result with
  | some dist => graph.is_shortest_distance start target dist
  | none => ¬ graph.reachable start target
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma
/-- There is a path from `start` to `v` using exactly `k` edges. -/
def PathTo (g : BFSGraph) (start v k : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∃ p : List Nat, g.is_path p ∧ p.head? = some start ∧ p.getLast? = some v ∧ p.length = k + 1

theorem snoc_of_getLast? : ∀ (p : List Nat) (v : Nat), p.getLast? = some v → ∃ q, p = q ++ [v]
  | [], _, h => by simp at h
  | [a], v, h => by
      simp only [List.getLast?_singleton, Option.some.injEq] at h
      exact ⟨[], by simp [h]⟩
  | a :: b :: t, v, h => by
      have h' : (b :: t).getLast? = some v := by
        rw [List.getLast?_cons_cons] at h; exact h
      obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := snoc_of_getLast? (b :: t) v h'
      exact ⟨a :: q, by rw [hq]; simp⟩

theorem getD_snoc_lt : ∀ (q : List Nat) (v i : Nat), i < q.length →
    (q ++ [v]).getD i 0 = q.getD i 0
  | [], _, _, h => by simp at h
  | _ :: _, _, 0, _ => by simp
  | a :: t, v, (i + 1), h => by
      have h' : i < t.length := by simp only [List.length_cons] at h; omega
      have hrec := getD_snoc_lt t v i h'
      simpa using hrec

theorem getD_snoc_eq : ∀ (q : List Nat) (v : Nat), (q ++ [v]).getD q.length 0 = v
  | [], _ => by simp
  | _ :: t, v => by simpa using getD_snoc_eq t v

theorem getLast?_eq_getD : ∀ (p : List Nat) (k : Nat), p.length = k + 1 →
    p.getLast? = some (p.getD k 0)
  | [], _, h => by simp at h
  | [_], 0, _ => by simp
  | [_], (_ + 1), h => by simp at h
  | _ :: _ :: _, 0, h => by simp at h
  | a :: b :: t, (k + 1), h => by
      have h' : (b :: t).length = k + 1 := by
        simp only [List.length_cons] at h ⊢; omega
      have hrec := getLast?_eq_getD (b :: t) k h'
      simpa using hrec

theorem mem_getD_lt {g : BFSGraph} {u v : Nat} (h : v ∈ g.adj.getD u #[]) : u < g.adj.size := by
  by_contra hc
  have hle : g.adj.size ≤ u := Nat.not_lt.1 hc
  have hempty : g.adj.getD u #[] = #[] := by
    simp [Array.getD, Array.getElem?_eq_none_iff, hle, Nat.not_lt.2 hle]
  rw [hempty] at h
  simp at h

theorem pathTo_start (g : BFSGraph) (start : Nat) : PathTo g start start 0 := by
  refine ⟨[start], ⟨by simp, ?_⟩, by simp, by simp, by simp⟩
  intro i hi
  simp only [List.length_singleton] at hi
  omega

theorem pathTo_step (g : BFSGraph) (start u v k : Nat) (hp : PathTo g start u k)
    (he : g.has_edge u v) : PathTo g start v (k + 1) := by
  obtain ⟨p, hpath, hhead, hlast, hlen⟩ := hp
  have hu : p.getD k 0 = u := by
    have hg := getLast?_eq_getD p k hlen
    rw [hlast] at hg
    exact (Option.some.injEq _ _ ▸ hg).symm
  have hplast : (p ++ [v]).getD p.length 0 = v := getD_snoc_eq p v
  refine ⟨p ++ [v], ?_, ?_, by simp, by simp [hlen]⟩
  · refine ⟨by simp, ?_⟩
    intro i hi
    simp only [List.length_append, List.length_singleton] at hi
    by_cases hik : i + 1 < p.length
    · rw [getD_snoc_lt p v i (by omega), getD_snoc_lt p v (i + 1) hik]
      exact hpath.2 i hik
    · have hik' : i = k := by omega
      rw [hik', getD_snoc_lt p v k (by omega), hu,
        show k + 1 = p.length by omega, hplast]
      exact he
  · cases p with
    | nil => simp at hlen
    | cons a t => simp at hhead ⊢; exact hhead

theorem pathTo_pred (g : BFSGraph) (start v k : Nat) (hp : PathTo g start v (k + 1)) :
    ∃ u, PathTo g start u k ∧ g.has_edge u v := by
  obtain ⟨p, hpath, hhead, hlast, hlen⟩ := hp
  obtain ⟨q, rfl⟩ := snoc_of_getLast? p v hlast
  have hqlen : q.length = k + 1 := by
    simp only [List.length_append, List.length_singleton] at hlen; omega
  have hplen : (q ++ [v]).length = k + 2 := by
    simp only [List.length_append, List.length_singleton, hqlen]
  refine ⟨q.getD k 0, ⟨q, ⟨by omega, ?_⟩, ?_, getLast?_eq_getD q k hqlen, hqlen⟩, ?_⟩
  · intro i hi
    have hedge := hpath.2 i (by rw [hplen]; omega)
    rw [getD_snoc_lt q v i (by omega), getD_snoc_lt q v (i + 1) hi] at hedge
    exact hedge
  · cases q with
    | nil => simp at hqlen
    | cons a t => simp at hhead ⊢; exact hhead
  · have hedge := hpath.2 k (by rw [hplen]; omega)
    rw [getD_snoc_lt q v k (by omega)] at hedge
    rw [show (q ++ [v]).getD (k + 1) 0 = v by rw [← hqlen]; exact getD_snoc_eq q v] at hedge
    exact hedge

theorem level_sound (g : BFSGraph) (start : Nat) :
    ∀ k v, v ∈ bfsLevel g start k → ∃ j, j ≤ k ∧ PathTo g start v j := by
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    intro v hv
    simp only [bfsLevel, Finset.mem_singleton] at hv
    refine ⟨0, le_rfl, ?_⟩
    rw [hv]
    exact pathTo_start g start
  | succ k ih =>
    intro v hv
    simp only [bfsLevel, bfsStep, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_biUnion,
      List.mem_toFinset] at hv
    rcases hv with hv | ⟨u, hu, hmem⟩
    · obtain ⟨j, hj, hp⟩ := ih v hv
      exact ⟨j, by omega, hp⟩
    · obtain ⟨j, hj, hp⟩ := ih u hu
      have hmem' : v ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] := by simpa using hmem
      exact ⟨j + 1, by omega, pathTo_step g start u v j hp ⟨mem_getD_lt hmem', hmem'⟩⟩

theorem level_complete (g : BFSGraph) (start : Nat) :
    ∀ k v, PathTo g start v k → v ∈ bfsLevel g start k := by
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    intro v hp
    obtain ⟨p, hpath, hhead, hlast, hlen⟩ := hp
    obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ : ∃ a, p = [a] := by
      cases p with
      | nil => simp at hlen
      | cons x t =>
        cases t with
        | nil => exact ⟨x, rfl⟩
        | cons y s => simp at hlen
    simp only [List.head?_cons, List.getLast?_singleton, Option.some.injEq] at hhead hlast
    have hvs : v = start := by omega
    simp [bfsLevel, hvs]
  | succ k ih =>
    intro v hp
    obtain ⟨u, hu, he⟩ := pathTo_pred g start v k hp
    have hmem := ih u hu
    simp only [bfsLevel, bfsStep, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_biUnion, List.mem_toFinset]
    exact Or.inr ⟨u, hmem, by simpa using he.2⟩

theorem level_range (g : BFSGraph) (start : Nat) (hwf : g.well_formed)
    (hs : start < g.adj.size) : ∀ k, bfsLevel g start k ⊆ Finset.range g.adj.size := by
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    intro x hx
    simp only [bfsLevel, Finset.mem_singleton] at hx
    simp [hx, hs]
  | succ k ih =>
    intro x hx
    simp only [bfsLevel, bfsStep, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_biUnion,
      List.mem_toFinset] at hx
    rcases hx with hx | ⟨u, hu, hmem⟩
    · exact ih hx
    · have hu' : u < g.adj.size := Finset.mem_range.1 (ih hu)
      have hmem' : x ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] := by simpa using hmem
      exact Finset.mem_range.2 (hwf u hu' x hmem')
-- !benchmark @end lemma

-- Proof content
theorem bfs_shortest_path_postcond_satisfied (graph : BFSGraph) (start target : Nat)
    (h_precond : bfs_shortest_path_precond graph start target) :
    bfs_shortest_path_postcond graph start target
      (bfs_shortest_path graph start target h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  have hwf : graph.well_formed := h_precond.1
  have hs : start < graph.adj.size := h_precond.2.2.1
  -- the levels are monotone
  have hmono : ∀ k m, k ≤ m → bfsLevel graph start k ⊆ bfsLevel graph start m := by
    intro k m hkm
    induction hkm with
    | refl => exact Finset.Subset.refl _
    | @step m _ ih =>
      intro x hx
      simp only [bfsLevel, bfsStep, Finset.mem_union]
      exact Or.inl (ih hx)
  -- once a level repeats, the sequence no longer changes
  have hstabstep : ∀ i, bfsLevel graph start (i + 1) = bfsLevel graph start i →
      ∀ j, i ≤ j → bfsLevel graph start j = bfsLevel graph start i := by
    intro i hi j hij
    induction hij with
    | refl => rfl
    | @step m _ ih =>
      have hstep : bfsLevel graph start (m + 1) = bfsStep graph (bfsLevel graph start m) := rfl
      rw [hstep, ih]
      exact hi
  -- pigeonhole: a repeat must happen within `graph.adj.size` steps
  have hfix : ∃ i, i < graph.adj.size ∧
      bfsLevel graph start (i + 1) = bfsLevel graph start i := by
    by_contra hcon
    push_neg at hcon
    have hcard : ∀ i, i ≤ graph.adj.size → i + 1 ≤ (bfsLevel graph start i).card := by
      intro i
      induction i with
      | zero => intro _; simp [bfsLevel]
      | succ j ih =>
        intro hj
        have h1 := ih (by omega)
        have hne := hcon j (by omega)
        have hsub : bfsLevel graph start j ⊆ bfsLevel graph start (j + 1) :=
          hmono j (j + 1) (by omega)
        have hlt : (bfsLevel graph start j).card < (bfsLevel graph start (j + 1)).card :=
          Finset.card_lt_card (Finset.ssubset_iff_subset_ne.2 ⟨hsub, fun h => hne h.symm⟩)
        omega
    have h1 := hcard graph.adj.size le_rfl
    have h2 : (bfsLevel graph start graph.adj.size).card ≤ graph.adj.size := by
      have hc := Finset.card_le_card (level_range graph start hwf hs graph.adj.size)
      simpa using hc
    omega
  obtain ⟨i, hin, hfixi⟩ := hfix
  -- hence every level is contained in the level at index `graph.adj.size`
  have hsubn : ∀ k, bfsLevel graph start k ⊆ bfsLevel graph start graph.adj.size := by
    intro k
    by_cases hk : k ≤ graph.adj.size
    · exact hmono k graph.adj.size hk
    · have heq : bfsLevel graph start k = bfsLevel graph start i :=
        hstabstep i hfixi k (by omega)
      rw [heq]
      exact hmono i graph.adj.size (by omega)
  unfold bfs_shortest_path
  split
  · rename_i hh
    have key : ∀ d : Nat, target ∈ bfsLevel graph start d →
        (∀ m, target ∈ bfsLevel graph start m → d ≤ m) →
        graph.is_shortest_distance start target d := by
      intro d hd hmin
      constructor
      · obtain ⟨j, hj, hpj⟩ := level_sound graph start d target hd
        have hjm : target ∈ bfsLevel graph start j := level_complete graph start j target hpj
        have hdj : d ≤ j := hmin j hjm
        have hjd : j = d := by omega
        subst hjd
        exact hpj
      · intro p hpath hhead hlast
        have hpos : p.length > 0 := hpath.1
        obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ : ∃ m, p.length = m + 1 := ⟨p.length - 1, by omega⟩
        have hpt : PathTo graph start target m := ⟨p, hpath, hhead, hlast, hm⟩
        have hle := hmin m (level_complete graph start m target hpt)
        omega
    exact key _ (Nat.find_spec (p := fun k => target ∈ bfsLevel graph start k)
      ⟨graph.adj.size, hh⟩) (fun m hm => Nat.find_min' _ hm)
  · rename_i hh
    intro hreach
    obtain ⟨p, hpath, hhead, hlast⟩ := hreach
    have hpos : p.length > 0 := hpath.1
    obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ : ∃ m, p.length = m + 1 := ⟨p.length - 1, by omega⟩
    have hpt : PathTo graph start target m := ⟨p, hpath, hhead, hlast, hm⟩
    exact hh (hsubn m (level_complete graph start m target hpt))
  -- !benchmark @end proof

`LEAN VERIFIED` — the proof compiles with no errors, no `sorry`, and no prohibited terms (only linter warnings about redundant simp arguments).

**What I implemented** (`Solution.lean`, only inside the four marker regions):

*auxcode* — BFS as level sets:
```lean
def bfsStep (g) (S) := S ∪ S.biUnion (fun u => ((g.adj.getD u #[]).toList).toFinset)
def bfsLevel (g) (start) : Nat → Finset Nat
  | 0 => {start}
  | k+1 => bfsStep g (bfsLevel g start k)
```

*code* — least level containing the target, guarded by a check at index `|V|`:
```lean
if hh : target ∈ bfsLevel graph start graph.adj.size then
  some (Nat.find (p := fun k => target ∈ bfsLevel graph start k) ⟨graph.adj.size, hh⟩)
else none
```

*lemma* — the bridge between levels and paths, via `PathTo g start v k` (a path of exactly `k` edges):
- snoc-manipulation lemmas (`snoc_of_getLast?`, `getD_snoc_lt`, `getD_snoc_eq`, `getLast?_eq_getD`) to handle the `getD`-indexed definition of `is_path`;
- `pathTo_step` / `pathTo_pred`: extend a path by an edge, and peel the last edge off;
- `level_sound` (`v ∈ bfsLevel k → ∃ j ≤ k, PathTo … j`) and `level_complete` (converse);
- `level_range`: levels stay inside `Finset.range |V|`, using `well_formed`.

*proof* — the three obligations:
- **Minimality**: `Nat.find_min'` plus `level_complete` — any path of `m` edges puts `target` in level `m`, so `d ≤ m`, giving `p.length ≥ d + 1`. `level_sound` + leastness pins the witness path to exactly `d` edges.
- **Level structure** (in place of queue invariants): monotonicity `bfsLevel k ⊆ bfsLevel (k+1)`, and stabilization — once `bfsLevel (i+1) = bfsLevel i`, all later levels equal it.
- **Unreachability**: pigeonhole. If no `i < |V|` repeated, cardinality strictly increases each step, so `|bfsLevel |V|| ≥ |V| + 1`, contradicting `bfsLevel |V| ⊆ range |V|`. Hence a repeat exists, so `bfsLevel k ⊆ bfsLevel |V|` for *every* `k` — the `none` branch means the frontier is genuinely exhausted, not merely unexplored.

One deliberate design note: I did not build a literal queue with `(k, k+1)`-sortedness invariants. The level-set formulation is extensionally the same search and makes the frontier argument tractable; the challenge-2 properties are discharged as the monotonicity/stabilization lemmas above rather than as statements about a queue's contents.
